sn22.36:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.36:1.3: ‘sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu, yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn22.36:1.4: yaṃ kho bhikkhu, anuseti taṃ anumīyati,
sn22.36:1.7: yaṃ nānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchatīti.
sn22.36:2.1: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsīti?
sn22.36:2.2: rūpaṃ ce bhante, anuseti taṃ anumīyati,
sn22.36:2.9: rūpaṃ ce bhante, nānuseti na taṃ anumīyati,
sn22.36:2.10: yaṃ nānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.36:2.14: …pe… viññāṇaṃ ce nānuseti na taṃ anumīyati,
sn22.36:2.15: yaṃ nānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.36:2.16: imassa kho’haṃ bhante, bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn22.36:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi:
sn22.36:3.10: rūpañce bhikkhu, nānuseti, na taṃ anumīyati.
sn22.36:3.16: yaṃ nānumīyati, na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati,
sn22.36:3.17: imassa kho bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti. atha kho so bhikkhu, bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkami. atha ākhā so bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto …pe…
sn22.36:3.18: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.
